title: Payment deposit tracking
description: Track a customer deposit or partial payment against a quote without implementing real payment processing.
constraints: No real payment gateway is introduced.
Deposit amounts are represented as deterministic fixture data.
acceptanceCriteria: A deposit can be recorded for a quote.
The system stores amount, date and note metadata.
The quote payment status reflects partial or complete deposit state.
The UI shows deposit status and remaining balance.
Invalid deposit amounts produce an explicit error.
Focused tests cover valid, invalid and status update cases.
expectedConflictNotes: Deposit state may conflict with quote status updates.
Tests depend on shared money and balance semantics.
